purpose: Existing HSQD spin-collapse comparator under the common fixed-source setup, not a novel algorithm or full native HCI-HSQD reproduction
reference: https://arxiv.org/html/2602.01165v1 Figure1 and Methods/Results spin-collapse mapping
source: Exactly the same fixed author-compressed one-layer LUCJ arrays and orbital basis as D2 and F2; not energy-selected
mapping: Keep one spin within-spin Jaa, map all cross a_i*b_j to a_i*a_j; spinless J=Jaa+2*Jab, keep source rotations and final rotation
half_configuration_selection: HF included, then descending observed frequency and numeric tie-break; each half string consumed once
readout_semantics: Identical frozen C2/C3/C4 and OO caps; finite-penalty Davidson is numerical not lowest-root certification, keep failures and all three modes
primary_screen: C3 finite-penalty physical energy, as F2/D2; no winning-spin-definition selection
finite_shot_budget: Same half-configurations as F2 at 100k shots, half those generated by full-register D2 at 100k shots
runtime: One CPU-only Slurm job, existing immutable package runtime; no environment installation; no GPU acceleration claim
